title: WORK-LAB 模型下载通道路由策略
purpose: Every model weight download must use a domestic route. Reaching huggingface.co here consumes the user's personal VPN, so it is forbidden by default rather than merely discouraged.

userDirective.text: 下载模型 尽量走国内通道，不要占据我的个人VPN
userDirective.interpretation: Applies to all model-weight and model-metadata traffic, including any tool that downloads on our behalf.

measuredEnvironment.huggingface.co_dns: 157.240.10.36 — a Facebook address, i.e. DNS pollution; not a real HF edge
measuredEnvironment.consequence: Any Hugging Face request is proxied through the user's local proxy/VPN. Foreign routes are therefore a real cost to the user, not a theoretical one.

preferred.name: hf-mirror
preferred.measured_throughput: single connection 0.766 MiB/s; 8 parallel ranged connections up to 13.4 MiB/s
preferred.notes: used for the Qwen2.5-VL model + mmproj via ggml-org

forbiddenByDefault.reason: foreign route; consumes the user's VPN

routes.override: A foreign route requires the explicit --allow-remote flag on the downloader AND a recorded reason. It is never selected automatically.

toolchain.canonicalDownloaderNote: The runner path is inside the deliberately untracked .project-local evidence area, so it does NOT exist in a fresh clone. To obtain it on another machine, extract it from the archived copy below and verify its sha256 against the archive manifest. The policy above is the normative part; the script is a convenience implementation of it.

canonicalDownloaderArchivedCopy.sha256Note: recorded for the 2026-09-29 archive (64 files). The authoritative value is always the one in MANIFEST.json; this field is a convenience cross-check and may change if the archive is rebuilt.

guarantees: refuses any foreign host before opening a connection
resolves sha256 from the mirror's own metadata instead of a hand-typed value
parallel ranged download with per-chunk retry (hf-mirror throttles a single connection)
verifies size, sha256 and the GGUF magic before promoting the file
idempotent: an already-present artifact with the right hash is skipped

rejectedTools.lms get: NOT used. It fetches from huggingface.co (consuming the VPN) and its model search is interactive, so it cannot be scripted or audited. Files are instead placed at <library>/<publisher>/<repo>/<file>.gguf, which LM Studio indexes in place because its model root IS the shared library (downloadsFolder).
rejectedTools.lms import: NOT needed. Newly placed files were indexed automatically with no import call, so no copy/move/link is performed and the single-physical-copy rule holds.

lmStudioDownloadSettings.note: Left as the vendor default. It only matters if the GUI downloader is used; the declared workflow never uses it.

verifiedWeights.note: moved from the Ollama store in-place; no download
